draft.subject: A first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Checking in once more on Blue Partners' Wrenfield setup. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the easiest place to start. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Nadia
